About The Role  



Project Role :Custom Software Engineer




Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.


Must have skills :Generative AI



Good to have skills :Machine Learning, Cloud Automation DevOps, Nvidia Omniverse
Minimum

3 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification :15 years full time education



Summary:We are looking for a skilled AI Refinery Developer to maintain, enhance, and scale an existing AI application/service built on AI Refinery (AIR). The solution is developed using FastAPI and is tightly integrated with NVIDIA Omniverse, enabling intelligent interactions within 3D environments. The role involves building AI-driven features, RAG-based systems, orchestrator services, and backend integrations to support 3D workflows and internal project needs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

-Maintain, optimize, and extend the existing AI application/service built on AI Refinery (AIR). -Enhance AI chat capabilities that respond using contextual information derived from the active 3D environment/scene. -Manage and improve orchestrator-based tool services used for manipulating or controlling 3D objects within NVIDIA Omniverse. -Develop and maintain RAG-based (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) answering systems for historical project documentation and knowledge retrieval. -Work with and configure multiple AIR services integrated into the application. -Ensure seamless connectivity between backend services, AI models, and 3D platform workflows. -Troubleshoot issues, optimize system performance, and ensure stability of AI-driven features. Professional & Technical Skills:
Must-Have Skills -Strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI for backend development. -Experience with AI Refinery (AIR), LangChain, or similar AI orchestration platforms. -Hands-on experience with AI/ML integrations in production environments. -Practical understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture and pipelines. -Experience working with SQL, NoSQL, and Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma). -Familiarity with document analysis, embedding models, and chat-based AI tools.Good to Have Skills -Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and DevOps practices. -Familiarity with 3D platforms or workflows, especially NVIDIA Omniverse. -Experience with orchestrator frameworks, API management, or microservices architecture.
Additional Information-Primary Skill:AI / Artificial Intelligence (as per Accenture standard taxonomy). -This role may require collaboration with cross-functional teams including 3D developers, AI engineers, and platform teams. -The project involves niche AI workflows that integrate deeply with 3D simulation and advanced visualization environments. -Exposure to NVIDIA technologies or synthetic data workflows will be an added advantage. -This position is based at our Bengaluru office. -A 15 years full time education is required.

 Qualification 15 years full time education
